title: 2008 HMMT February Team Round 1 Problem 8
statement:
Show that for positive integers \(n_{1}, n_{2}\) and \(d\),

\[f\left(n_{1} n_{2}, d\right) \leq f\left(n_{1}, d\right)+n_{1}\left(f\left(n_{2}, d\right)-1\right)\]

solutions.text: Given a multiset of \(f\left(n_{1}, d\right)+n_{1}\left(f\left(n_{2}, d\right)-1\right)\) lattice points, we may select \(l=f\left(n_{2}, d\right)\) pairwise disjoint submultisets \(S_{1}, S_{2}, \ldots, S_{l}\), each consisting of \(n_{1}\) points, whose centroid is a lattice point. Let \(\varphi\) map each multiset \(S_{i}\) to its centroid \(g_{i}\). By the definition of \(f\left(n_{2}, d\right)\), there exists a submultiset \(T \subset\left\{g_{1}, g_{2}, \ldots, g_{l}\right\}\) satisfying \(|T|=n_{2}\) whose centroid is a lattice point. Then \(\bigcup_{i \in T} \varphi^{-1}\left(g_{i}\right)\) is a multiset of \(n_{1} n_{2}\) lattice points whose centroid is also a lattice point.
